# Test Fixtures

This directory contains sample files used in E2E tests.

## Files needed:
- sample-id.jpg - Sample ID image (can be any small JPG)
- sample-age-proof.pdf - Sample age verification document (can be any small PDF)
- sample-contract.pdf - Sample contract document (can be any small PDF)

For testing purposes, these can be simple placeholder files. In a real environment, you would use proper test data.
